description.en:
Basic Attack

Press or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.

Basic Attack - Spark Collision

With full Overflow in the Optical Sampling Stage, hold Normal Attack to enter a charging state.
During this state, 15 points of Overflow will be converted to 12.5% of Lumiflow every 0.2s. Lynae is immune to interruption and takes 50% less DMG.
Upon releasing Normal Attack or when Lumiflow is full, Lynae casts Spark Collision of varying strengths based on the ratio of Lumiflow, dealing Spectro DMG:
- Spark Collision Lv. 1: Lumiflow <50%
- Spark Collision Lv. 2: 50% ≤ Lumiflow < 100%
- Spark Collision Lv. 3: Lumiflow=100%

Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack

While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, Basic Attack is replaced with Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack.
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG.
With 120 points of Lumiflow, Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 1 & 4 track enemies in a greater distance.

Kaleidoscopic Parade - Ground Heavy Attack

While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, hold Normal Attack on the ground to cast this skill. Consume STA to continuously attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG. Release to cast Kaleidoscopic Parade - Graffiti Blast, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack

While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, hold Normal Attack in mid-air to cast this skill. Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
Cannot gain new charges while in the air. The available charges reset when Lynae is the active Resonator and is on the ground.

Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Attack

While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, Mid-air Attack is replaced with Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Attack.
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.

Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter

While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, Dodge Counter is replaced with Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter.
Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Tekan atau tahan Normal Attack untuk melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Spectro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack tepat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG.

Basic Attack - Spark Collision

Dengan Overflow penuh pada Optical Sampling Stage, tahan Normal Attack untuk memasuki kondisi pengisian.
Selama kondisi ini, 15 poin Overflow akan dikonversi menjadi 12,5% Lumiflow setiap 0,2 dtk. Lynae kebal terhadap interupsi dan menerima 50% lebih sedikit DMG.
Saat Normal Attack dilepas atau saat Lumiflow penuh, Lynae melancarkan Spark Collision dengan kekuatan berbeda berdasarkan rasio Lumiflow, memberikan Spectro DMG:
- Spark Collision Lv. 1: Lumiflow <50%
- Spark Collision Lv. 2: 50% ≤ Lumiflow < 100%
- Spark Collision Lv. 3: Lumiflow=100%

Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack

Saat dalam Kaleidoscopic Parade, Basic Attack diganti dengan Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack.
Melakukan hingga 5 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Spectro DMG.
Dengan 120 poin Lumiflow, Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Tahap 1 & 4 melacak musuh pada jarak yang lebih jauh.

Kaleidoscopic Parade - Ground Heavy Attack

Saat dalam Kaleidoscopic Parade, tahan Normal Attack di darat untuk melancarkan skill ini. Mengonsumsi STA untuk terus menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG. Lepas untuk melancarkan Kaleidoscopic Parade - Graffiti Blast, memberikan Spectro DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.

Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack

Saat dalam Kaleidoscopic Parade, tahan Normal Attack di udara untuk melancarkan skill ini. Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.
Tidak dapat memperoleh charge baru saat di udara. Charge yang tersedia diatur ulang saat Lynae adalah Resonator aktif dan berada di darat.

Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Attack

Saat dalam Kaleidoscopic Parade, Mid-air Attack diganti dengan Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Attack.
Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Spectro DMG.

Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter

Saat dalam Kaleidoscopic Parade, Dodge Counter diganti dengan Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter.
Tekan Normal Attack tepat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG.
Saat dalam Kaleidoscopic Parade, tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Tahap 2.

description.en:
Lynae-Style Palettes

Press Resonance Skill to deal Spectro DMG.
While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, hold Resonance Skill to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and exiting the Kaleidoscopic Parade.
Press Normal Attack within a certain time after this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
Lynae-Style Palettes and Additive Color share a cooldown.

Additive Color

During Kaleidoscopic Parade, press Resonance Skill on the ground to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
Within a certain time during the skill, press Normal Attack to cast Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2.
Lynae-Style Palettes and Additive Color share a cooldown.
description.id:
Lynae-Style Palettes

Tekan Resonance Skill untuk memberikan Spectro DMG.
Saat dalam Kaleidoscopic Parade, tahan Resonance Skill untuk menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG dan keluar dari Kaleidoscopic Parade.
Tekan Normal Attack dalam jangka waktu tertentu setelah skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 2.
Lynae-Style Palettes dan Additive Color berbagi cooldown.

Additive Color

Selama Kaleidoscopic Parade, tekan Resonance Skill di darat untuk menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG.
Dalam jangka waktu tertentu selama skill, tekan Normal Attack untuk melancarkan Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Tahap 2.
Lynae-Style Palettes dan Additive Color berbagi cooldown.

description.en:
Deal Spectro DMG. Casting this skill increases the DMG dealt by all nearby Resonators in the team by 24% for 30s.

Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow!

Press Normal Attack within a certain time after casting Resonance Liberation - Prismatic Overblast to cast Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow!, dealing Spectro DMG.
While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, press Normal Attack within a certain time during the skill to cast Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2.
description.id:
Memberikan Spectro DMG. Melancarkan skill ini meningkatkan DMG yang diberikan seluruh Resonator di sekitar dalam tim sebesar 24% selama 30 dtk.

Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow!

Tekan Normal Attack dalam jangka waktu tertentu setelah melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Prismatic Overblast untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow!, memberikan Spectro DMG.
Saat dalam Kaleidoscopic Parade, tekan Normal Attack dalam jangka waktu tertentu selama skill untuk melancarkan Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Tahap 2.

attributes.name: Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow! DMG

description.en:
After casting Basic Attack - Visual Impact, Lynae leaves Spray Paint on the ground and continuously inflicts Photochromic Flux on targets within the Spray Paint for 5s, triggered once every 2s. When Spray Paint is on the ground, switching to another Resonance Mode doesn't affect the Photochromic Flux effects inflicted by the Spray Paint.

With Lynae in the team, the expedition motorbike's Energy Tank expands by 600 points. Lynae enters Kaleidoscopic Parade automatically while on the expedition motorbike and restores 20% of Lumiflow per second.
description.id:
Setelah melancarkan Basic Attack - Visual Impact, Lynae meninggalkan Spray Paint di tanah dan terus memberikan Photochromic Flux pada target di dalam Spray Paint selama 5 dtk, terpicu sekali setiap 2 dtk. Saat Spray Paint ada di tanah, berganti ke Resonance Mode lain tidak memengaruhi efek Photochromic Flux yang diberikan oleh Spray Paint.

Dengan Lynae di tim, Energy Tank motor ekspedisi bertambah 600 poin. Lynae otomatis memasuki Kaleidoscopic Parade saat berada di motor ekspedisi dan memulihkan 20% Lumiflow per detik.

description.en:
Casting Intro Skill - Time to Show Some Colors! increases Lynae's Spectro DMG Bonus by 25% for 9s.

During Kaleidoscopic Parade, if Lynae isn't in combat, dodging without directional input grants her Optic Camo for 15s, which will be removed when Lynae casts any skill other than dodging or is switched off the field. Performing environmental, gameplay or functional interactions, or entering combat, removes the Optic Camo. With Optic Camo, Lynae may enter the enemy's aggro range without triggering combat.
description.id:
Melancarkan Intro Skill - Time to Show Some Colors! meningkatkan Spectro DMG Bonus Lynae sebesar 25% selama 9 dtk.

Selama Kaleidoscopic Parade, jika Lynae tidak dalam pertempuran, melakukan dodge tanpa input arah memberinya Optic Camo selama 15 dtk, yang akan dihapus saat Lynae melancarkan skill apa pun selain dodge atau diganti keluar lapangan. Melakukan interaksi lingkungan, gameplay, atau fungsional, atau memasuki pertempuran, menghapus Optic Camo. Dengan Optic Camo, Lynae dapat memasuki jangkauan aggro musuh tanpa memicu pertempuran.

description.en:
Deal Spectro DMG, inflicting Photochromic Flux on targets hit.
While in Optical Sampling Stage, casting this skill recovers 100 points of Overflow.
description.id:
Memberikan Spectro DMG, memberikan Photochromic Flux pada target yang terkena.
Saat dalam Optical Sampling Stage, melancarkan skill ini memulihkan 100 poin Overflow.

attributes.name: Time to Show Some Colors! DMG

description.en:
Optical Sampling Stage

Lynae is in Optical Sampling Stage by default. While in this state, Overflow recovers during certain skills.

Kaleidoscopic Parade

Casting Basic Attack - Spark Collision sends Lynae into Kaleidoscopic Parade. In this state, Lynae continuously recovers Lumiflow while moving on the ground or during certain periods of certain skills. Lynae will not Walk during this state, and her Running and Sprinting will be replaced by the faster Free Skating and Speed Skating.

Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap

While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, with at least 1/3 of the max Lumiflow, Jump is replaced by Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap.
Consume 1/3 of the max Lumiflow to deal Spectro DMG. Inflict Photochromic Flux on targets hit. Successful Dodges can be triggered within a certain time during this skill. While airborne, Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap chains up to 3 stages. Switching to another Resonator resets the combo.
While in combat, each stage of Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap cast recovers 1 point of True Color.
Within a certain time after Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Stage 1 press Normal Attack on the ground to cast Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2.
Casting Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Stage 2 also pulls in nearby targets.

Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash

During Kaleidoscopic Parade, when Lynae is in mid-air with 3 points of True Color, and Basic Attack - Visual Impact is on cooldown, press Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to deal Spectro DMG and inflict Photochromic Flux on targets hit.
This skill consumes 3 points of True Color.
Press Normal Attack within a certain time during this skill to cast Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2.

Basic Attack - Visual Impact

During Kaleidoscopic Parade, when Lynae is in mid-air with 3 points of True Color, and this skill is not on cooldown, press Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to deal Spectro DMG and inflict Photochromic Flux on targets hit.
This skill consumes 3 points of True Color and grants all nearby Resonators in the team 40 points of Tune Break Boost for 30s.
Press Normal Attack within a certain time during this skill to cast Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2.

Resonance Mode

Inflict Photochromic Flux when hitting a target with Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap, Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash, Basic Attack - Visual Impact and Intro Skill - Time to Show Some Colors!.
Lynae can switch between Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture and Resonance Mode - Tune Strain:
- When in Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture, Photochromic Flux inflicts Tune Rupture - Shifting on targets for 25s.
- When in Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, Photochromic Flux inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on targets for 25s.

Tune Rupture Response - Spectral Analysis

Deal an instance of Spectro DMG, considered Tune Rupture DMG, to targets within range affected by Tune Rupture - Interfered.

Overflow

Lynae can hold up to 120 points of Overflow.
While in Optical Sampling Stage, Overflow recovers during Basic Attack, Lynae-Style Palettes, Mid-air Attack, and Dodge Counter, or when Intro Skill is cast.
When Overflow is full, Basic Attack - Spark Collision becomes available.
Casting Basic Attack - Spark Collision removes all Overflow.

Lumiflow

Lynae can hold up to 120 points of Lumiflow.
During Kaleidoscopic Parade:
- Restore 20% of Lumiflow per second when Lynae is moving on the ground/climbing, or performs a successful Dodge on the ground, or within a certain time during Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack, Kaleidoscopic Parade - Ground Heavy Attack, Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack, Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter, Additive Color, ground Dodge, Intro Skill, or Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow!.
- Lumiflow starts to deplete by 20% per second while Lynae is staying still on the ground/climbing/swimming or off the field, or after a certain time following the use of the skills listed above.
- Lumiflow does not change while Lynae is not in any of the states described above.
Exiting Kaleidoscopic Parade removes all Lumiflow.
With 120 points of Lumiflow, Lynae's roller skating speed further increases. Speed Skating consumes STA over time.

True Color

Lynae can hold up to 3 points of True Color.
During combat, each time Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap is cast, gain 1 point of True Color. With 3 points of True Color, Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash and Basic Attack - Visual Impact become available.
Exiting Kaleidoscopic Parade removes all True Color.
description.id:
Optical Sampling Stage

Lynae berada dalam Optical Sampling Stage secara default. Saat dalam kondisi ini, Overflow dipulihkan selama skill tertentu.

Kaleidoscopic Parade

Melancarkan Basic Attack - Spark Collision membawa Lynae ke Kaleidoscopic Parade. Dalam kondisi ini, Lynae terus memulihkan Lumiflow saat bergerak di darat atau selama periode tertentu pada skill tertentu. Lynae tidak akan Walk selama kondisi ini, dan Running serta Sprinting miliknya diganti dengan Free Skating dan Speed Skating yang lebih cepat.

Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap

Saat dalam Kaleidoscopic Parade, dengan setidaknya 1/3 dari Lumiflow maksimum, Jump diganti dengan Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap.
Mengonsumsi 1/3 dari Lumiflow maksimum untuk memberikan Spectro DMG. Memberikan Photochromic Flux pada target yang terkena. Dodge berhasil dapat terpicu dalam jangka waktu tertentu selama skill ini. Saat di udara, Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap merangkai hingga 3 tahap. Berganti ke Resonator lain mengatur ulang kombo.
Saat dalam pertempuran, setiap Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap yang dilancarkan pada tiap tahap memulihkan 1 poin True Color.
Dalam jangka waktu tertentu setelah Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Tahap 1, tekan Normal Attack di darat untuk melancarkan Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Tahap 2.
Melancarkan Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Tahap 2 juga menarik target di sekitar.

Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash

Selama Kaleidoscopic Parade, saat Lynae di udara dengan 3 poin True Color, dan Basic Attack - Visual Impact sedang cooldown, tekan Normal Attack atau Resonance Skill untuk memberikan Spectro DMG dan memberikan Photochromic Flux pada target yang terkena.
Skill ini mengonsumsi 3 poin True Color.
Tekan Normal Attack dalam jangka waktu tertentu selama skill ini untuk melancarkan Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Tahap 2.

Basic Attack - Visual Impact

Selama Kaleidoscopic Parade, saat Lynae di udara dengan 3 poin True Color, dan skill ini tidak sedang cooldown, tekan Normal Attack atau Resonance Skill untuk memberikan Spectro DMG dan memberikan Photochromic Flux pada target yang terkena.
Skill ini mengonsumsi 3 poin True Color dan memberikan 40 poin Tune Break Boost kepada seluruh Resonator di sekitar dalam tim selama 30 dtk.
Tekan Normal Attack dalam jangka waktu tertentu selama skill ini untuk melancarkan Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Tahap 2.

Resonance Mode

Memberikan Photochromic Flux saat mengenai target dengan Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap, Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash, Basic Attack - Visual Impact dan Intro Skill - Time to Show Some Colors!.
Lynae dapat berganti antara Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture dan Resonance Mode - Tune Strain:
- Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture, Photochromic Flux memberikan Tune Rupture - Shifting pada target selama 25 dtk.
- Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, Photochromic Flux memberikan Tune Strain - Shifting pada target selama 25 dtk.

Tune Rupture Response - Spectral Analysis

Memberikan satu kali Spectro DMG, dianggap sebagai Tune Rupture DMG, ke target dalam jangkauan yang terkena Tune Rupture - Interfered.

Overflow

Lynae dapat menyimpan hingga 120 poin Overflow.
Saat dalam Optical Sampling Stage, Overflow dipulihkan selama Basic Attack, Lynae-Style Palettes, Mid-air Attack, dan Dodge Counter, atau saat Intro Skill dilancarkan.
Saat Overflow penuh, Basic Attack - Spark Collision tersedia.
Melancarkan Basic Attack - Spark Collision menghapus seluruh Overflow.

Lumiflow

Lynae dapat menyimpan hingga 120 poin Lumiflow.
Selama Kaleidoscopic Parade:
- Pulihkan 20% Lumiflow per detik saat Lynae bergerak di darat/memanjat, atau melakukan Dodge berhasil di darat, atau dalam jangka waktu tertentu selama Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack, Kaleidoscopic Parade - Ground Heavy Attack, Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack, Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter, Additive Color, Dodge di darat, Intro Skill, atau Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow!.
- Lumiflow mulai berkurang sebesar 20% per detik saat Lynae diam di darat/memanjat/berenang atau berada di luar lapangan, atau setelah waktu tertentu setelah penggunaan skill yang tercantum di atas.
- Lumiflow tidak berubah saat Lynae tidak berada dalam kondisi apa pun yang dijelaskan di atas.
Keluar dari Kaleidoscopic Parade menghapus seluruh Lumiflow.
Dengan 120 poin Lumiflow, kecepatan roller skating Lynae meningkat lebih lanjut. Speed Skating mengonsumsi STA seiring waktu.

True Color

Lynae dapat menyimpan hingga 3 poin True Color.
Selama pertempuran, setiap kali Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap dilancarkan, dapatkan 1 poin True Color. Dengan 3 poin True Color, Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash dan Basic Attack - Visual Impact tersedia.
Keluar dari Kaleidoscopic Parade menghapus seluruh True Color.

description.en:
Attack the target and deal 100% Spectro DMG. The next incoming Resonator gain 15% All DMG Amplification and 25% Resonance Liberation DMG Amplification for 14s or until they are switched out.
Lynae leaves the Kaleidoscopic Parade state upon casting Outro Skill.
description.id:
Menyerang target dan memberikan 100% Spectro DMG. Resonator masuk berikutnya mendapat Amplify All DMG sebesar 15% dan Amplify Resonance Liberation DMG sebesar 25% selama 14 dtk atau hingga mereka diganti keluar.
Lynae keluar dari kondisi Kaleidoscopic Parade saat melancarkan Outro Skill.

description.en:
Lynae can inflict Tune Rupture - Shifting or Tune Strain - Shifting on targets.
Lynae can respond to Tune Rupture - Interfered and Tune Strain - Interfered.
- Responding to Tune Rupture - Interfered: When any Resonator in the team deals Tune Break DMG and inflicts the Tune Rupture - Interfered state, Lynae casts Tune Rupture Response - Spectral Analysis. Each target can be damaged by this skill up to once every 8s.
- Responding to Tune Strain - Interfered: For each stack of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target, each point of Lynae's Tune Break Boost increases her total DMG against that target by 0.12%. When Lynae is in the team, the target's max stack limit of Tune Strain - Interfered is increased by 1.
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Lynae can cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id:
Lynae dapat memberikan Tune Rupture - Shifting atau Tune Strain - Shifting pada target.
Lynae dapat merespons Tune Rupture - Interfered dan Tune Strain - Interfered.
- Merespons Tune Rupture - Interfered: Saat Resonator mana pun di tim memberikan Tune Break DMG dan memberikan kondisi Tune Rupture - Interfered, Lynae melancarkan Tune Rupture Response - Spectral Analysis. Setiap target dapat menerima damage dari skill ini paling banyak sekali setiap 8 dtk.
- Merespons Tune Strain - Interfered: Untuk setiap stack Tune Strain - Interfered pada target, setiap poin Tune Break Boost Lynae meningkatkan total DMG-nya terhadap target tersebut sebesar 0,12%. Saat Lynae ada di tim, batas stack maksimum Tune Strain - Interfered pada target bertambah 1.
Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Lynae dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

sequences.name: Days to be Painted Like a Canvas

description.en:
The DMG Multiplier of Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap is increased by 120%.
The duration of Spray Paint is increased by 100%. Targets within the range of Spray Paint are pulled in towards the center every 6s.
Lynae is now immune to interruptions during Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap and Basic Attack - Visual Impact.
During Optical Sampling Stage, after staying in a non-combat state for 2s, restore 120 points of Overflow every 2s.
description.id:
Pengali DMG Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap meningkat sebesar 120%.
Durasi Spray Paint meningkat sebesar 100%. Target dalam jangkauan Spray Paint ditarik ke pusat setiap 6 dtk.
Lynae kini kebal terhadap interupsi selama Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap dan Basic Attack - Visual Impact.
Selama Optical Sampling Stage, setelah berada dalam kondisi non-pertempuran selama 2 dtk, pulihkan 120 poin Overflow setiap 2 dtk.

description.en:
Gain 25% All DMG Amplification.
Outro Skill gains the following effect:
Casting Outro Skill now additionally grants the incoming Resonator 25% All DMG Amplification for 14s or until the Resonator is switched out.
description.id:
Mendapat Amplify All DMG sebesar 25%.
Outro Skill mendapat efek berikut:
Melancarkan Outro Skill kini juga memberikan Amplify All DMG sebesar 25% kepada Resonator yang masuk selama 14 dtk atau hingga Resonator diganti keluar.

description.en:
The DMG Multiplier of Basic Attack - Visual Impact and Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash is increased by 90%.
While Lynae is in combat, when Lumiflow is at least 120 points, gain 1 stack of Premixed Hue every 1s, up to 25 stacks. Each stack of Premixed Hue increases the Spectro DMG Bonus of Additive Color by 55%. No Premixed Hue is gained while casting Additive Color. When Additive Color ends, remove all stacks of Premixed Hue. Lynae loses a stack of Premixed Hue every 0.5s when Lumiflow is below 120 points.
While Lynae is out of combat, with at least 120 points of Lumiflow, gain 1 stack of Premixed Hue every 0.5s; when Lumiflow is below 120 points, lose 1 stack of Premixed Hue every 1s.
description.id:
Pengali DMG Basic Attack - Visual Impact dan Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash meningkat sebesar 90%.
Saat Lynae dalam pertempuran, ketika Lumiflow minimal 120 poin, dapatkan 1 stack Premixed Hue setiap 1 dtk, hingga 25 stack. Setiap stack Premixed Hue meningkatkan Spectro DMG Bonus Additive Color sebesar 55%. Tidak ada Premixed Hue yang didapat saat melancarkan Additive Color. Saat Additive Color berakhir, hapus seluruh stack Premixed Hue. Lynae kehilangan satu stack Premixed Hue setiap 0,5 dtk saat Lumiflow di bawah 120 poin.
Saat Lynae di luar pertempuran, dengan minimal 120 poin Lumiflow, dapatkan 1 stack Premixed Hue setiap 0,5 dtk; saat Lumiflow di bawah 120 poin, kehilangan 1 stack Premixed Hue setiap 1 dtk.

description.en: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation - Prismatic Overblast is increased by 70%.
description.id: Pengali DMG Resonance Liberation - Prismatic Overblast meningkat sebesar 70%.

description.en:
Each time Kaleidoscopic Parade - Graffiti Blast or Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack is cast, Lynae gains 1 stack of Color of Soul, up to 3 stacks. Each stack of Color of Soul increases the DMG the target takes from Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash and Basic Attack - Visual Impact by 30%. After casting Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash or Basic Attack - Visual Impact, all stacks of Color of Soul are removed.
Casting Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap resets the charges of Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack.
Lynae is immune to interruptions, and DMG taken is reduced by 30% during Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack.
Lynae now stays in Kaleidoscopic Parade after casting Outro Skill - Let's Hit the Road!.
The Lumiflow upper limit is increased from 120 to 360. At the max limit, Lynae's roller skating speed further increases.
If Intro Skill is cast during Kaleidoscopic Parade, restore 120 points of Lumiflow.
description.id:
Setiap kali Kaleidoscopic Parade - Graffiti Blast atau Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack dilancarkan, Lynae mendapat 1 stack Color of Soul, hingga 3 stack. Setiap stack Color of Soul meningkatkan DMG yang diterima target dari Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash dan Basic Attack - Visual Impact sebesar 30%. Setelah melancarkan Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash atau Basic Attack - Visual Impact, seluruh stack Color of Soul dihapus.
Melancarkan Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap mengatur ulang charge Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack.
Lynae kebal terhadap interupsi, dan DMG yang diterima berkurang 30% selama Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack.
Lynae kini tetap berada di Kaleidoscopic Parade setelah melancarkan Outro Skill - Let's Hit the Road!.
Batas atas Lumiflow meningkat dari 120 menjadi 360. Pada batas maksimum, kecepatan roller skating Lynae meningkat lebih lanjut.
